subject.title: feat(feishu): pass through form_value, input_value, option(s) from card actions

question: What agent-visible payload format should Feishu card-action callbacks use when `form_value`, `input_value`, `name`, `option`, or `options` are present?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but linked attempts differ between structured JSON pass-through and command-text appending, and that choice affects downstream agents and plugin authors.

options.title: Structured JSON Payload
options.body: Pass `action.value` plus Feishu form/input/select fields as JSON text while preserving legacy simple button command extraction.

options.title: Command-Text Append
options.body: Append form/select fields into the existing command text path, minimizing command-routing changes but making complex values harder to parse reliably.

options.title: Pause For Plugin Contract Review
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until the Feishu payload contract is explicitly settled with plugin owners.

recommendation.title: Structured JSON Payload
recommendation.body: Pass `action.value` plus Feishu form/input/select fields as JSON text while preserving legacy simple button command extraction.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package metadata names this handle as the community-maintained contact for the affected plugin payload contract.
